LESSON: THE HUMAN BREATHING SYSTEM

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
Strand: Living Things and their Environment
Topic 1.2: The Human Breathing System

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on The Human Breathing System. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What makes up the human breathing system?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the main parts of the human breathing system
2. describe the functions of parts of the human breathing system

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: THE HUMAN BREATHING SYSTEM
This lesson teaches The Human Breathing System for Grade 5 SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the main parts of the human breathing system
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. describe the functions of parts of the human breathing system
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe The Human Breathing System using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about The Human Breathing System above.
2. Explain The Human Breathing System to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand The Human Breathing System.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Human Breathing System with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is The Human Breathing System important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What makes up the human breathing system?
2. What enhances a healthy breathing system?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the main parts of the human breathing system
2. describe the functions of parts of the human breathing system

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
